label: Town of Fletcher
header:
# Town of Fletcher municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 9; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists five Fletcher Selectboard members: Jennifer Getty (Chair), Matt Gillilan, Alex Sargent, Rob Schukei, and Matt Swartz; the directory seats all five after the March 2026 meeting, including the two whose seats stood.

Town of Fletcher 2025 Annual Report (fletchervt.net), printing the TOWN/SCHOOL OFFICERS table and the 2026 Warning: the officers table prints Getty, Gillilan, Sargent, Schukei, and Swartz with terms running to 2027 and 2028.

Town of Fletcher 2025 Annual Report (fletchervt.net), printing the TOWN/SCHOOL OFFICERS table and the 2026 Warning: the officers table lists David Clark as Moderator on a one-year term expired 2026; the 2026 Warning stood the office and no outcome is published. Structure only. Clark is seated as a justice of the peace below.

Town of Fletcher 2025 Annual Report (fletchervt.net), printing the TOWN/SCHOOL OFFICERS table and the 2026 Warning: Fletcher elects its Town Clerk and Town Treasurer as ONE combined ballot office ('Town Clerk & Treasurer', three-year term); the two standard posts are modeled with the combination stated here. Karrie Sweet's term expired in 2026, the office stood, and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Karrie Sweet as both Fletcher Town Clerk and Town Treasurer (January 2026).

Town of Fletcher 2025 Annual Report (fletchervt.net), printing the TOWN/SCHOOL OFFICERS table and the 2026 Warning: Fletcher elects its Town Treasurer jointly with the Town Clerk as one combined ballot office ('Town Clerk & Treasurer'); see the Town Clerk post. Karrie Sweet's term expired in 2026, the office stood, and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Karrie Sweet as both Fletcher Town Treasurer and Town Clerk (January 2026).

Town of Fletcher 2025 Annual Report (fletchervt.net), printing the TOWN/SCHOOL OFFICERS table and the 2026 Warning: the officers table lists Sharon Tinker (term to 2027), Andrew Davis, and Charles E. Tinker; the Davis and C. E. Tinker seats both expired in 2026 and stood at the meeting (a three-year seat and a two-year remainder on the 2026 Warning) with no published outcome, so they are left unfilled.

Town of Fletcher 2025 Annual Report (fletchervt.net), printing the TOWN/SCHOOL OFFICERS table and the 2026 Warning: the officers table lists Nancy Cardinal and Andrea Zamuda (terms to 2028) and Kathryn Towle; Towle's seat stood in 2026 with no published outcome, so it is left unfilled.

Town of Fletcher 2025 Annual Report (fletchervt.net), printing the TOWN/SCHOOL OFFICERS table and the 2026 Warning: the officers table lists Bill Stygles as First Constable on a two-year term running to 2027.

Town of Fletcher 2025 Annual Report (fletchervt.net), printing the TOWN/SCHOOL OFFICERS table and the 2026 Warning: the officers table lists Fred Fletcher as Collector of Delinquent Taxes on a three-year term expired 2026; the office stood at the 2026 meeting and no outcome is published. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists three Fletcher justices of the peace: Todd Baumeister, Jeremy Ayotte, and David Clark; the town's officers table concurs.
